text.en:
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 187
DIRECTING ALL DEPARTMENTS, BUREAUS, OFFICES AND OTHER BRANCHES OF THE GOVERNMENT TO USE THE FILIPINO LANGUAGE, AS FAR AS PRACTICABLE, DURING THE NATIONAL LANGUAGE WEEK AND THEREAFTER, IN ALL OFFICIAL COMMUNICATIONS AND TRANSACTIONS OF THE GOVERNMENT
WHEREAS, the development and propagation of a national Filipino language, as provided for in the Constitution and in Commonwealth Act No. 570, is one of the principal objectives of the government;
WHEREAS, our national language, now accepted and recognized by all as "Filipino", is one of the important elements of nationalism that can impel our nation towards greater progress, stability and unity;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law and in pursuance of the objectives of the Constitution and of Commonwealth Act No. 570, do hereby direct and declare that the Filipino language be used, as far as practicable, in all departments, bureaus, offices and other branches of the government during the Language Week and thereafter, in all communications and transactions of the government.
Done in the City of Manila, this sixth day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-nine.
(Signed) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Signed) ERNESTO M. MACEDA
Executive Secretary
[Translated from the original Filipino text.]
